C Systems

Async TCP Layer 4 Gateway

High-concurrency asynchronous Layer 4 TCP gateway/proxy using epoll. Features round-robin load balancing, instant failover, async health checks with auto-recovery, IPv6 dual-stack, token bucket rate limiting (global + per-IP), and SIGUSR1 metrics observability.

NeoShare Local Cloud

Zero-dependency HTTP file server built from scratch with Python stdlib. Threaded architecture, directory traversal protection, 2GB upload limit (DoS prevention), HTTP Range streaming for video seeking, auto tar.gz folder downloads, and auto dark/light theme detection.
